The single header also embeds code from the following MIT-licensed projects:

* Grisu2 binary-to-decimal floating-point conversion, a modified version of the
  reference implementation by Florian Loitsch.
  Copyright (c) 2009 Florian Loitsch.
  http://florian.loitsch.com/publications

* A fast UTF-8 decoder (DFA) by Bjoern Hoehrmann, adapted to use std::array.
  Copyright (c) 2008-2009 Bjoern Hoehrmann <bjoern@hoehrmann.de>
  http://bjoern.hoehrmann.de/utf-8/decoder/dfa/
